segment.source: Renders a two-column opening band: headline, lead and actions in one half, a single image or illustration in the other, with a toggle that swaps the sides. Use it for: product pages that need the interface visible immediately, service pages carrying a photograph, single-offer landing pages, campaign pages with a key visual. Prefer 'Product Hero' when the image is wide enough to sit under the copy, and 'Full-Bleed Image Hero' when the picture should carry the whole band on its own.
